title: Permitted Parking
previewText: Developments or enlargements in the Hudson Yards parking regulations applicability area may provide accessory parking spaces in accordance with the provisions of this Section. The provisions of Sections 36-52 (Size, Location and Identification of Spaces) and 36-53 (Width of Curb Cuts and Location of Access to the Street) shall apply to all permitted accessory off-street parking spaces.
